name: drop-word-case
description:
Words by the case of their letters (find and extract only); digits and punctuation do not count.

kind: "lower" (no capital letter: «x5»); "Capital" (each run of letters starts with a capital, the rest small: «Москве», not «iPhone» or «Из-за»); "CAPS" (no small letter: «BMW», «В»).

drop-word-case drops the rows where the matcher finds something in the working column.

Example: semkit read core.csv drop-word-case Capital write out.csv

options.name: --kind
options.description: "lower" (no capital letter: «x5»); "Capital" (each run of letters starts with a capital, the rest small: «Москве», not «iPhone» or «Из-за»); "CAPS" (no small letter: «BMW», «В»).

arguments.name: KIND
arguments.description: "lower" (no capital letter: «x5»); "Capital" (each run of letters starts with a capital, the rest small: «Москве», not «iPhone» or «Из-за»); "CAPS" (no small letter: «BMW», «В»). The same as --kind KIND.
